mission.title: Run the Fox to Ground
mission.description: Find where Veil is holding a secret meeting, and find out who she is meeting.

phase.briefing:
Things are heating up, Warrior. We've received reports that an important meeting will be taking place soon. A meeting between Veil, and someone powerful. We're not sure who she's meeting; that's where you come in.
We need you to get into that meeting, however you can. The first step is finding the location. Search all of the computers at the location on your HUD. If you run into any interference, do as you will.

enter.say: Okay, I'm reading 3 computer terminals in there. We should be able to put together the info and figure out where this meeting is at...

complete.say: Seems like some sort of code... I'll forward it to Tyndall and Gray, and see if they can turn up anything. In the meantime, get out of there!

phase.briefing:
Gray has run those numbers through his encryption programs, and turned up a couple of likely spots. The Machines are helping us again, hitting one of the spots. We need you to get the other one.
Head on in. Take care of any opposition you encounter, and find out who Veil is meeting!

enter.say: I'm reading a bunch of signals in there, including... yep. Veil is definitely on site. Don't waste this opportunity!

done.say:
What in the world... the signals were there a moment ago, and now there's just this weird residual signal. It seems familiar somehow...
More to the point, though, I've got a destination on these signals too. The Machines are already on their way. You'd better head on over before they get all the glory!

phase.briefing:
I just got cut off from Gray. We've been in constant communication up to this point... what can that mean?
Maybe the Machines need our help! Get to the new meeting location as fast as you can, Warrior!

enter.say: This spot seems awfully quiet... I don't like it. Be careful in there, {player}.

objective.text: Search the bodies of the Zion operatives

done.say:
Oh, no... those are dead Zion operatives! And not a live signal on the screen... what happened here?
I think you should get out of there, {player}.
It seems like someone searched these bodies already...

mission.finish:
This is a sad day, Warrior. Apparently one of our hovercraft crews got a little too hot headed, and went in with no backup. And somehow... somehow, someone unplugged their jacks.
Keep this in mind. Don't let your emotions run away with you... we now have no idea who this meeting was with. And we don't know who unplugged those poor souls...
Keep in touch. This is not over.
